stories.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles into East Sea
new_facts: North Korea fired ballistic missiles; Seoul coordinating info with US and Japan
JCS specifies missiles were multiple short-range ballistic missiles
Launch follows a military drill North Korea views as a threat
Missiles flew approximately 250 km, per JCS
JCS reports multiple ballistic missiles fired, not a single one
stories.line: North Korea launched multiple short-range ballistic missiles into the East Sea, traveling about 250 km, in apparent response to perceived military threats.
